start.dialog: My instruments detected anomalous readings from the ancient ruins beneath the waves. Pre-Collapse architecture—possibly from the First Age! I can't explore them myself; my suit isn't rated for deep water pressure. But you... you could investigate!
start.objective: Explore the sunken ruins beneath Tidemark Bay

progress.dialog: Incredible! These ruins predate the Collapse by millennia! I need you to activate the central mechanism—it looks like some kind of recording device. But be careful, there are automated defenses! Ancient guardians still patrol the halls!
progress.objective: Activate the central mechanism and defeat the ancient guardians

complete.dialog: A holographic recording! This is historic! It shows... wait, this changes everything we know about pre-Collapse civilization! Here's your payment, and this Ancient Data Core. It may contain more secrets—take it to a scholar in the Uplands!

party_comments.kade: Ancient technology underwater? What else is hiding down there?
party_comments.twist: Those guardians used magic I've never seen before. Fascinating.
party_comments.nix7: Pre-Collapse data storage: intact. Historical value: immeasurable.
